code:
use default

cycle_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    for start in 0..values.count - 1 do
        let item mut = values[start]
        let position mut = start

        for i in start + 1..values.count do
            if values[i] < item then
                position = position + 1
            fi
        od

        if position == start then
            continue
        fi

        while item =~ values[position] do
            position = position + 1
        od

        (values[position], item) = (item, values[position])

        while position != start do
            position = start

            for i in start + 1..values.count do
                if values[i] < item then
                    position = position + 1
                fi
            od

            while item =~ values[position] do
                position = position + 1
            od

            let cycled = values[position]

            values[position] = item
            item = cycled
        od
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

cycle_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

cycle_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
